title: Alpha Flight #72 Marvel Comics 1989 Evil in Edmonton
descriptionText:
Alpha Flight #72 (July 1989, Marvel Comics) -- "Evil in Edmonton!" Cover price $1.50 US.

Condition: Very Good. I have three copies of this issue; condition may vary slightly between copies, but all are in a similar Very Good range -- please review all photos as they're of the actual copy/copies you'll receive.
